title: Nocturne v2.22.27 is officially out! 🚀
content:
Hey everyone! 👋 We just released Nocturne **v2.22.27** with full Live Cloud Announcements sync & publishing, unified grouped-list design, and performance improvements!

• **Live Cloud Broadcasts**: Real-time announcements synced worldwide across all devices.
• **Grouped-List Design**: Unified sleek containers with rounded top/bottom corners.
• **Connected Auto-Playlists**: Liked, Downloaded, Top 50, and Cached in Library.
• **Battery Optimization Controls**: Prevent playback terminations in background.

Update now from Settings -> Check for update!

title: Nocturne v2.22.26 is officially out! 🚀
content:
Hey everyone! 👋 We just released Nocturne **v2.22.26** with major improvements:

• **Grouped-List UI Design**: Redesigned all Settings and sub-screens with connected rounded containers.
• **Connected Auto-Playlists**: Liked, Downloaded, Top 50, and Cached playlists now seamlessly grouped in Library.
• **Apple Music Lyrics & Sliders**: Fully wired lyrics animations and custom sliders.
• **Battery Optimization**: Added background battery optimization settings to prevent audio interruptions.
• **New Announcement Feed**: Real-time broadcast channel with rich reactions & announcements!

Update now from Settings -> Check for update!

title: Welcome to Nocturne Broadcast! 🚀
content:
Hey everyone! 👋 Welcome to the official Nocturne Announcements channel.

Here you'll get direct updates on upcoming features, releases, hotfixes, and changelogs straight from the developer. React to this message to show your excitement!
